find_module_instances: find all occurrences of a given module class among a PyTorch module's children and return their state_dict-style paths
replace_by_prefix: replace all keys matching a given old prefix with a new prefix in a PyTorch state_dict in place
find_layer_norm_modules: find all LayerNorm module instances and their paths within a PyTorch neural network module
rename_state_dict_keys: rename state_dict keys by replacing an old prefix string with a new prefix string
inspect_module_tree: inspect a PyTorch module tree to locate all instances of a specific module subclass
